Union of Socialist Groups and Clubs
notes: Philip Savage served as Director of Player Personnel for the Baltimore Ravens under general manager Ozzie Newsome from 2003-2004.
Ozzie Newsome was inducted into both the College Football Hall of Fame (1994) and the Pro Football Hall of Fame (1999).
Ozzie Newsome was drafted higher than Steve Little in the 1978 NFL Draft.
Steve Little was drafted lower than Ozzie Newsome in the 1978 NFL Draft.

per_hop.query:
SELECT 
  ph.name AS philip_savage_name,
  ph.role AS philip_savage_role,
  gm.name AS general_manager_name,
  gm.tenure_start,
  gm.tenure_end,
  d.position AS draft_position_steve_little,
  gm_draft.position AS draft_position_general_manager,
  gm_college_hof.inducted AS gm_college_hof_status,
  gm_pro_hof.inducted AS gm_pro_hof_status
FROM
  personnel ph
JOIN
  general_managers gm ON ph.team = gm.team AND ph.tenure_start BETWEEN gm.tenure_start AND gm.tenure_end
JOIN
  draft d ON d.player = 'Steve Little'
JOIN
  draft gm_draft ON gm_draft.player = gm.name
LEFT JOIN
  college_football_hall_of_fame gm_college_hof ON gm_college_hof.player = gm.name
LEFT JOIN
  pro_football_hall_of_fame gm_pro_hof ON gm_pro_hof.player = gm.name
WHERE
  ph.name = 'Philip Savage' AND
  ph.role LIKE '%Director of Player Personnel%' AND
  ph.team = 'Baltimore Ravens' AND
  d.position < gm_draft.position AND
  gm_college_hof.inducted = TRUE AND
  gm_pro_hof.inducted = TRUE;
retrieved_titles: List of New York Mets owners and executives

per_hop.query:
SELECT 
  ps.name AS director_name,
  gm.name AS general_manager,
  st.name AS player_name,
  st.draft_position AS player_draft_position,
  gm_draft_position.draft_position AS gm_draft_position,
  gm_college_hof.inducted AS gm_college_hof_inducted,
  gm_pro_hof.inducted AS gm_pro_hof_inducted
FROM 
  staff_positions AS ps
JOIN 
  teams AS t ON ps.team_id = t.id
JOIN 
  general_managers AS gm ON t.id = gm.team_id AND ps.tenure_start <= gm.tenure_end AND ps.tenure_end >= gm.tenure_start
JOIN 
  players AS st ON st.name = 'Steve Little'
JOIN 
  players AS gm_player ON gm_player.name = gm.name
LEFT JOIN 
  draft_positions AS st_draft_position ON st.id = st_draft_position.player_id
LEFT JOIN 
  draft_positions AS gm_draft_position ON gm_player.id = gm_draft_position.player_id
LEFT JOIN 
  hall_of_fame AS gm_college_hof ON gm_player.id = gm_college_hof.player_id AND gm_college_hof.type = 'College'
LEFT JOIN 
  hall_of_fame AS gm_pro_hof ON gm_player.id = gm_pro_hof.player_id AND gm_pro_hof.type = 'Pro'
WHERE 
  ps.name = 'Philip Savage' AND
  ps.position = 'Director of Player Personnel' AND
  t.name = 'Baltimore Ravens'
LIMIT 1;
retrieved_titles: Union of Socialist Groups and Clubs
